title: Antiek native container manifest
description: Schema-version 1.0.0 of the .antiek manifest.json. See services/antiek_format/SPEC.md for normative prose. Major-version bumps require a new schema file alongside this one.

schema_version.description: Semver M.m.p. Major-mismatch refuses; minor-mismatch warns.

document_id.description: Substrate-resident id. For per-doc notebooks this matches notebook_documents.document_id.

parent_document_id.description: Source PDF for a per-doc notebook; null for theme_notebook or deliverable.

parent_pdf_sha256.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the parent PDF bytes. REQUIRED when content_class == 'pdf_sidecar'; null/absent otherwise. Used by the receiving substrate to verify the sidecar matches the imported PDF.

parent_pdf_size_bytes.description: Byte length of the parent PDF at sidecar-write time. Carried alongside parent_pdf_sha256 so a length-mismatch warning can fire before a hash compute on huge PDFs. REQUIRED when content_class == 'pdf_sidecar'.

parent_pdf_filename_hint.description: The PDF's original basename at write time. Informational only — the substrate does NOT match on this; it's surfaced in the UI so the user can recognise which file the sidecar was made for if the hash check fails.

highlights_present.description: Hint flag — does highlights.jsonl exist? (Sidecar variant only; reader skips probe when absent.)

anchors_present.description: Hint flag — does anchors.jsonl exist? (Sidecar variant only.)

chunker_version_at_write.description: Informational: substrate.voice.CHUNKER_VERSION at sidecar-write time. The reader does NOT trust this — it re-resolves each anchor under the receiving substrate's chunker (SPEC.md §11.3). Carried so a chunker-delta warning can be surfaced if the receiving substrate's version differs.
